verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical. Each stacks the headline, then the window, then right-aligned details, and both share the same flaws: the details block crowds right under the window's bottom edge and sticks out past its right side, the window sits off-centre to the left with no shared axis with the left-aligned headline, and the headline wraps awkwardly onto three lines. A is slightly more balanced from top to bottom, while B sits too high, with a tight top margin and a dead gap at the bottom.
